entries.title: Psalms 85:1
segments:
PSALM LXXXV. 
 
  A recital of past, and prayer for present mercy, ver. 1-7.   A prediction of a favourable answer, ver. 8-13.   To the chief musician, A psalm for the sons of Korah. 
 
  V. 1. Captivity-The captives.

entries.title: Psalms 85:4
segments: V. 4. Turn us-Restore us to our former tranquillity, and free us from the troubles which we yet groan under.

entries.title: Psalms 85:6
segments: V. 6. Revive us-Give us a second reviving in bringing home the rest of our brethren, and in restraining our enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 85:8
segments: V. 8. Will hear-Diligently observe.  Will speak-What answer God will give to my prayers.  Peace-He will give an answer of peace. Saints-Not to all that are called God's people, but only to those who are truly such.

entries.title: Psalms 85:9
segments: V. 9. His salvation-That compleat salvation for which all the Israel of God wait; even the redemption by the Messiah; of which not only Christian, but even Jewish writers understand this place; and to which the following passages properly belong.  And the psalmist might well say this salvation was nigh, because the seventy weeks determined by Daniel were begun.  Glory-The glorious presence of God, and the God of glory himself, even Christ, who is the brightness of his father's glory.

entries.title: Psalms 85:10
segments: V. 10. Kissed-That great work of redemption by Christ, shall clearly manifest God's mercy in redeeming his people Israel, and in the conversion of the Gentiles; his truth in fulfilling that great promise of sending his son, his righteousness in punishing sin, on his son, and in conferring righteousness upon guilty and lost creatures; and his peace or reconciliation to sinners, and that peace of conscience which attends upon it.

entries.title: Psalms 85:11
segments: V. 11. Truth-Truth among men.  Righteousness-And God's justice shall be satisfied: he shall look down upon sinful men with a smiling countenance.

entries.title: Psalms 85:13
segments: V. 13. Before him-As his harbinger.  He shall fulfil all righteousness, he shall satisfy the righteousness of God, and shall advance righteousness and holiness among men.  Set us-Shall cause us to walk in those righteous ways wherein he walketh.
